title: Atomic vector batch accepts reserved lock and journal paths as output targets
description: atomic_write_json_batch validates same-directory unique Path objects but does not reject destinations named .lichen-vector-batch.lock or .lichen-vector-batch.transaction.json. Replacing the lock path swaps out the flocked inode, so another writer can open and lock a different inode concurrently; targeting the journal also corrupts transaction metadata. Reject reserved names before serialization or filesystem mutation and add exact no-mutation regressions.
